# Module `error`

Display Aspect - General formatting interface

The Display aspect provides string representation for any type.
This is not error-specific - it's a general-purpose formatting aspect
similar to Rust's Display trait or Java's toString().

Errable Aspect - Core error type interface

Any type implementing Errable can be used with fail/trap error handling.
This aspect defines the minimum interface for error types in Vyb.

<a id="file-stdlib-error-error-vyb"></a>
**File: `stdlib/error/error.vyb`**

Error - Base error type for Vyb standard library

This struct wraps the runtime VybError infrastructure and provides
a Vyb-level interface to error handling. All stdlib errors should
either use this directly or compose with it.
